participation.context: Heard the rumour, did not turn the leaf, and did not add his own example.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Kept to books he can show, and had not seen the new one.
participation.name: John Harrison

participation.context: Had not seen it either, and would not own a title he had not printed.
participation.name: Richard Field

story.body: You listened to three men who had not seen the book. You kept Daniel open at the same leaf. You did not describe the play in Garnish's chest.

participation.context: Heard the title, looked at Burbage, and said nothing of his own books.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Kept the groom's facts apart from the growing talk.
participation.name: George Bryan

participation.context: Asked for the short version, and did not name the play.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Asked where the news was heard, and believed only that far.
participation.name: Alice Brambleby

relations.note: she will believe the source and not the enlargement
relations.quote: Say where you heard it, Master Bryan, and I'll know how much to believe.

story.body: You let Bryan finish the report. You did not put the book on the table, and you did not answer Burbage's look with a speech. You ate, and you left the number of leaves at home.

title: Heard the groom's report at the Hazel
